text_blocks.snippet: Losartan is generally well tolerated, but it can cause side effects ranging from mild, temporary reactions to serious medical concerns. You can review detailed prescribing information via MedlinePlus Drug Information or learn more from the Mayo Clinic.
snippet_highlighted_words: mild, temporary reactions to serious medical concerns

text_blocks.snippet: Most common side effects are mild and tend to improve as your body adjusts to the medication:

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness (especially when standing up quickly)
Upper respiratory symptoms like a stuffy nose, sinus pressure, or cold-like symptoms
Digestive issues such as mild nausea, diarrhea, or upset stomach
Back, leg, or joint pain / muscle cramps

text_blocks.snippet: Serious Side Effects (Seek Immediate Medical Care)
Contact your doctor right away or seek emergency help if you experience signs of a severe reaction or complication:

list.snippet: Allergic reaction (angioedema): Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, throat, or mouth, or trouble breathing or swallowing.
High potassium levels (hyperkalemia): Muscle weakness, confusion, slow, fast, or irregular heartbeat, or feeling faint.
Kidney problems: Little to no urination, swelling in your hands, ankles, or feet, or unexplained weight gain.
Severe low blood pressure: Extreme dizziness, lightheadedness, or fainting.
